items.desc: €11.99 per person, all taxes included, and nothing added at checkout. That covers the official Ministry of Culture ticket bought in your name, a digital audio guide, WhatsApp support, and free cancellation until we send your ticket.

faqPage.ctaBody: Independent booking service · Official ticket included · Free cancellation

items.answer: Choose your date and complete checkout with us. We buy your official Ministry of Culture ticket and send your QR code by email and WhatsApp before your visit. Prefer to buy it yourself? You can, at e-services.minculture.gov.ma.

You can cancel or change your date for free via WhatsApp any time before your QR ticket is delivered — full refund. Once the ticket is delivered, the service is provided; see our Refund Policy for details.
After you book with us, we send your official QR code ticket by email and WhatsApp before your visit.
Free cancellation and date changes via WhatsApp any time before your QR ticket is delivered.
Your booking includes the official pre-validated entry ticket, so you skip the ticket-booth queue.

cheaper.a: Entry alone is 100 MAD at the gate. Our price covers that ticket bought in your name, plus the audio guide in five languages, the visitor map, WhatsApp support before and during your visit, and free cancellation right up until we send your QR code. The Ministry also sells entry directly on its own portal if that is all you need.
